lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 001: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: Reviewer finding on the US-001 regression test (test/commands/config-frontmatter.test.ts, 'inserts a frontmatterBody containing $-sequences verbatim') has been addressed: the test's three .toContain() assertions did not actually discriminate the pre-fix buggy string-form replace() call, because against the buggy code $& expands to the whole matched fence (which itself contains the note text), and the corrupted, fence-duplicated output still satisfied all three .toContain() checks. Strengthened to expect(result).toBe(<full exact expected string>) plus two exactly-once assertions (result.split(noteSubstring).length === 2, result.split('---').length === 3). Empirically re-verified against a standalone repro of the old string-form replace(/fence/, updatedFence) call: the buggy output fails toBe (fence duplicated), fails the fence-count check (5 vs 3), and fails the note-occurrence check (2 vs 1) -- confirming the new test now genuinely discriminates the bug. No production code changed in this story (test-only fix).
